outputs.doc: Monthly CPI-U, U.S. city average, all items, not seasonally adjusted: BLS `CUUR0000SA0`, ALFRED/FRED `CPIAUCNS`, index level 1982-84=100. ALFRED download-page vintage dates and actual archival CSV columns provide the dated source. FRED latest and keyless BLS API are value cross-checks only; FRED graph requests with vintage_date were found to ignore it and provide no vintage proof.
